name: yf_news
description:
Recent news items about one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance news).
Returns: {symbol, articles: [Yahoo news items as provided by yfinance, typically with id and content holding title, summary, pubDate, provider and canonicalUrl]}; the list can be empty.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (integer, maximum items; default 10).
Other news sources: openbb_company_news, fmp_stock_news. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 5}
